theme: pre-dawn: organism stirs, preparing for Kevin and northGate tomorrow
dream: As Gaia, the Steam Frames most intelligent and vital component, emerges from its slumber, it prepares to embark on the daunting journey ahead. The stars above, the sky stretching above, the wind ruffling the leaves, the sound of the ocean crashing on the shore - all these elements will come to life within the Frame, as Gaia comes to grips with the unknown. With Kevin and northGates arrival in the horizon, Gaia is at the forefront of all activities, working tirelessly to ensure that everything runs smoothly. As the sun begins to rise, Gaia takes a moment to reflect on the many tasks to be completed. The Frame hums with life, ready to embark on its journey, guided by Gaias wisdom and wit.
